test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 12 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some trees are fish.

All fishes are goats.

No goat is a flower.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some trees are goats.

II. Some fishes are not flowers.

III. Some flowers are not goats.
solution:
Given Statements:

Some trees are fish.

All fishes are goats.

No goat is a flower.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53c14886d30e50ddd46caf304dbaea669db3dc311aef32d986874534ae464644.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some trees are goats - True (Because, Some trees are fish and all fishes are goats, so those part of fish that is trees is also goats).

II. Some fishes are not flowers - True (Because, All fishes are goats and No goat is a flower, so Some fishes are not flowers).

III. Some flowers are not goats - True (Because, No goat is a flower, so Some flowers are not goats).

So, All conclusions follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
